measurementMethod: Read image dimensions and major background transitions with System.Drawing; visually estimate interior geometry. No browser execution or fidelity pass is claimed.

header.layout: logo left; compact nav and solid CTA right

hero.layout: full bleed mountain photograph with pale left gradient; eyebrow then large two-line serif title; subtitle and two CTAs below
hero.subjectPosition: mountain mass across right half; lower-right photo credit

sectionIndex.layout: six equal columns, small number above label, thin vertical separators

qualification.layout: two columns, heading and introduction left, evidence heading and table right

projects.layout: soft pale-green opening; section title left and summary right; three full-width horizontal project rows; photographs consistently left, text right
projects.rowDividers: thin light lines spanning the full content width
projects.ctaPlacement: small underlined project link at far right, aligned with project title

benefits.layout: heading in left 36%; intro and three partnership directions in right 59%; full-width 3-column benefits table underneath; disclosure below table

process.layout: full pale-green band; left title takes about 33%; right horizontal 4-step timeline
process.nodeStyle: pine circles with white two-digit numbers; thin continuous connector; labels and compact descriptions below

contact.layout: white two-column section: title left; example contact, explanatory paragraph, email and WeChat status in right

bDownloadGeometry.layout: dark pine full-width band; title, body, download CTA and A4 detail on left; oversized physical book on right
bDownloadGeometry.coverTreatment: white actual handbook cover; mountain image in lower half; clockwise tilt approximately 12–15 degrees plus mild perspective; visible light page thickness along bottom and left; soft dark cast shadow
bDownloadGeometry.integrationAdvice: Use A's section eyebrow/title language and overall grid, applying B's protruding cover, left-aligned download CTA, perspective, book thickness and overlap. Keep cover inside viewport on compact screens; preserve downloadable link.
bDownloadGeometry.assetAdvice: Export the real PDF first page for the cover image so webpage book and downloadable handbook match.

contentGuardrails: Generated Chinese text is visual reference only. Do not transcribe malformed glyphs or awkward project descriptions.
Use only the three approved sample project categories: snow-mountain climbing, ice-climbing specialty, and year-round training with leader development.
Names, qualifications, projects and contact placeholders must visibly remain examples. Do not imply independently verified certifications or expedition achievements.
Use exact team/school names from the existing repository data, not generated cover/footer glyphs.
Do not treat an outdoor first-aid training example or rope-skill training example as a formal credential.
Amounts, quantities, delivery dates, display rights and equipment usage authorization remain subject to discussion.
